unmapped_blocks.text: Worked with Hardware/Software Vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Silver Peak, etc. to resolve problems.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Juniper Certified Network Associate (JNCIA)
Fortinet NSE-1
Fortinet NSE-2
Silver Peak SDWAN certification-SPSX
Oracle Cloud Foundations Associate.
CERTIFICATIONS
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Senior Network & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 6+ years of experience supporting large-scale cloud
and data centre networks. Expertise in OCI networking, GPU/RDMA fabrics, SD-WAN, MPLS, and high-
availability architectures. Strong hands-on experience in P1/P2 incident management, Python-based
automation, and real-time monitoring using Grafana and Prometheus. Proven ability to operate in multi-
vendor environments including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and NVIDIA
Mar 2024 – Present
Oracle INC | Sr. GNOC Engineer
Supported backend and data centre networks for NVIDIA GB200 project, enabling next-generation AI
infrastructure.
Supported and scaled backend and data centre networks for the NVIDIA GB200 AI infrastructure project,
enabling next-generation GPU-based compute platforms.
Led operations and support for OCI GPU RoCE RDMA fabrics and cluster networking, delivering ultra-low
latency, high-throughput connectivity for large-scale AI/ML workloads.
Served as primary on-call engineer, resolving 92% of P1/P2 incidents within SLA, significantly reducing
downtime and customer impact across global regions.
Led initial incident response for OCI physical networks across 50+ regions (Data Centre Fabric, Transit,
Backbone, WDM), coordinating with on-site teams, ISPs, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Actively participated in P1/P2 incident bridges, performing deep-dive investigations, executing
mitigations, and contributing to RCA when physical networking issues were suspected.
Designed and maintained real-time monitoring dashboards using Grafana and Prometheus, improving
visibility, alerting, and proactive detection across global data centres.
Developed Python automation tools to analyse 5,000+ network devices, automate firmware upgrades,
and streamline day-to-day network operations.
Operated and troubleshot Clos leaf–spine architectures across multi-vendor environments (Arista,
Juniper, Cisco, NVIDIA), while planning and executing OS upgrades, RMAs, configuration changes.
Mentoring IC3 engineers, managers, and senior leaders on OCI network architecture and best practices.
Provided 24*7 network support services to 100+ global customers having distributed LAN/WAN setup.
Troubleshooting various issue like Node/ link down, routing, latencies, packet-loss on various type of
links: T1/E1, T3/E3, DSL, Ethernet/MPLS & backbone links.
Worked with Telecommunication Service Providers to resolve escalated circuit problems to resolution.
Coordinating & joint troubleshooting on issues with worldwide ISPs like AT&T, XO-Verizon, Lumen:
CenturyLink - Level3, Vodafone, SFR, Cogent, TATA, Airtel etc.
Day-to-day working on SDWAN technologies like Silver Peak & Cisco-Viptela. Planning & performing
various break-fix
Activities like upgrades or RMA of various network devices in stipulated timeframe.
Managed the firmware upgrade of Silver Peak Orchestrator and 1500 SDWAN devices, minimizing
downtime and ensuring network stability.
Created SOP documents for L1 engineers, improving efficiency in handling Silver Peak deployments and
upgrades.
Oct 2021 – Feb 2024
NTT Global Networks Limited | Engineer - Network Operations
